Container.Name: CineDock
Container.Overview: Rediscover your library. CineDock gives Plex, Emby or Jellyfin an enhanced browsing experience on the NVIDIA Shield TV, on an Amazon Fire TV Stick, or in a browser on your computer or tablet.
Container.Changes:
### 4.3.5 (18 August 2026) - Completes the More Info redesign released in 4.3.4 the same day: the trailer on the info screen did not actually play on a television (it was held behind a check on a flag the Plex connection never sets - measured 0 of 25 films on Plex reporting a trailer where 20 really had one). It now plays, with sound, once, after a short pause, and stops as soon as you press Play or leave the page. The TRAILER badge follows what is really playing, and audio badges drop the technical qualifier so "5.1(side)" reads "5.1". Browsers, phones and the TV app (0.2.4) unchanged.
### 4.3.4 (18 August 2026) - The More Info screen is redesigned for televisions: the whole page now fits one screen for a film and for a long-running series alike (it ran to 1.5 and over 3 screens before), text no longer sits on artwork, and the description is larger. Media info (resolution, HDR/Dolby Vision, codec, frame rate, audio format) is shown per title and per episode, along with director, studio and country. Seasons and episodes have their own screens that open on where you are up to. Marking watched is now signposted, and the two actions that cannot be undone ask first. A trailer plays with sound in a box on the page where your server has one. Browsers, phones and the TV app (0.2.4) are unchanged.
### 4.3.3 (18 August 2026) - Zidoo support: the interface now displays correctly on Zidoo players (Z9X 8K tested) - the TV app always gets the television layout and older-engine layout gaps are filled. Pairs with the Fire TV / Shield / Zidoo app 0.2.4, which on a Zidoo plays through the box's own player. Other devices unchanged.
### 4.3.2 (17 August 2026) - Performance: first launch and every launch after an idle spell now show Home in about a second instead of 12-15 s on Plex (no more waiting on Plex to compute its hubs; Home is served from cache and refreshed in the background; pre-warmed at container start). No feature changes; Fire TV / Shield app unchanged (0.2.3).
### 4.3.1 (16 August 2026) - Bug fixes: removed an empty navy band that sat over the top menu on a TV app's first launches; Search and Requests pages no longer open under the header; in-app help points at cinedock.tv/support. Fire TV / Shield app unchanged (0.2.3).
### 4.3.0 (16 August 2026) - Browse All: every library as a full poster grid (sort, unwatched and genre filters), paged and windowed for large libraries. - A-Z rail, Genres page, and "See all" on New Releases / Recently Added / genre rows. - Library sub-menu on the second line of the top menu; inset billboard on every tab. - Fire TV fixes: rail inside overscan, "#"/"A" off-screen, grid opening low, lagging letter marker. - Works on Emby, Jellyfin and Plex. TV app unchanged (0.2.2).
### 4.2.1 (14 August 2026) - Plex artwork now delivered at display size (both dimensions sent to the transcoder); artwork cache key versioned. - Hidden Gems and Short and Sweet smart collections wired into Plex Home; Settings checkbox enabled for Plex.
### 4.2.0 (13 August 2026) - Chapter preview images via bundled ffmpeg from an optional read-only media mount (size-capped cache). - Hidden Gems and Short and Sweet smart collections across Plex, Emby and Jellyfin. - Watchlist promoted to a top-navigation destination.
Full history: https://github.com/cinedock/unraid-templates/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
Container.Description: Rediscover your library. CineDock gives Plex, Emby or Jellyfin an enhanced browsing experience on the NVIDIA Shield TV, on an Amazon Fire TV Stick, or in a browser on your computer or tablet. CineDock does not scan, copy or change media files. Install the container, open its web page and connect your media server.
Container.DonateText: Enjoying CineDock? Support its continued development.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The port you open in your browser to use CineDock.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Where CineDock stores its server connection and small caches.

Config.Name: TMDB API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. A free TMDB key adds actor biographies, filmographies and improves spotlight selection. It does not supply trailer video files. CineDock works without it.

Config.Name: Emby server address (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Full Emby address, for example http://192.168.1.20:8096. Add it with the API key to make TV setup a single connection test.

Config.Name: Emby API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Store the Emby API key in the container so it does not need to be entered on the television setup screen.

Config.Name: Jellyfin server address (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Full Jellyfin address, for example http://192.168.1.20:8096. Add it with the API key to make TV setup a single connection test.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Store the Jellyfin API key in the container so it does not need to be entered on the television setup screen.

Config.Name: Plex server address (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Full local Plex address, for example http://192.168.1.20:32400. Add it with the token to make Plex immediately selectable; secure account linking remains available when blank.

Config.Name: Plex token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. Store the Plex token in the container for immediate server switching, or leave blank to use secure Plex account linking.
